gazetteer_names_needed.name: Saudi-Kuwaiti Neutral Zone
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: 5,770 km2 diamond south of Kuwait, about 28.2-29.1 N, 46.9-48.5 E; partitioned 1966-1970. The dossier uses Cliopatria differences instead, so the name is optional.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Saudi-Iraqi Neutral Zone
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: 7,044 km2 kite on the Najd-Iraq frontier, about 29 N, 44.5-46.5 E; partitioned 1982. Also used in kingdom-of-iraq (as cells); optional.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Rub' al Khali
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: The Empty Quarter, about 17-23 N, 45-56 E, southern Saudi Arabia into Oman, the UAE and Yemen; the 1936 Cliopatria jump.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Buraimi Oasis
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Al Buraymi (Oman) and Al Ain (UAE), about 24.25 N, 55.77 E; the dossier uses a radius around Al Ayn.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Hamasa
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Village of the Buraimi oasis, occupied by Saudi guards 31 August 1952.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Ghajar
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Border-straddling village at the Lebanon-Israel-Syria tripoint, about 33.28 N, 35.62 E; used as a 5 km radius around those coordinates (my reading, not a page).

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Shebaa Farms
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Small disputed territory on the Lebanon-Israel-Syria border, about 33.3 N, 35.7 E; named in the dossier text, not used as a region.

gazetteer_names_needed.name: Mosul vilayet
gazetteer_names_needed.hint: Ottoman vilayet of Mosul, today Ninawa, Kirkuk, Erbil, Dohuk and Sulaymaniyah; used as a union of five admin-1 names.

gaps.what: The 1936 jump of about 1,205 cells (the Rub' al Khali) has no dated act on any page; recorded at confidence 1.

Battle of Khafji and the Gulf War, the 1969 Al-Wadiah war, the Qatar and UAE frontiers (1974 Treaty of Jeddah text, 2008 Qatar agreement) and the Houthi border war are not read beyond one sentence each.
Small cell changes in the 1943, 1946, 1947, 1958 and 1960 shapes and three cells on the Yemen frontier in 1990 are unexplained; read as noise.

1958 insurrection, Taif Agreement text, Free Lebanon State and South Lebanon provisional administration, Palestinian bases, the Syrian civil war spillover cell of 2014 and the Malkiyya cells of 1946-1947 are not read.
The 1978 withdrawal has no month on the Lebanon page, so the Israeli hold is drawn as a border strip from March 1978; the 2024 invasion and Ghajar have no end event.
The 1920 revolt, the 1930 treaty, the frontiers with Iran (1937), Kuwait and Transjordan and the withdrawal of the 1948 expeditionary force are not read; the Kingdom of Iraq infobox gives no area.
Cells added in 1947 (eastern desert) and 1949 (Golan and Jordan valley, larger than the 66 km2 Syria kept), the French evacuation of 1945-1946 and the demilitarised zones after 1949 are not read.

counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Free Lebanon State / South Lebanon provisional administration (Israeli-backed security zone)

problems: No dossier is unwritten; 23 distinct pages were opened (Saudi Arabia 9, Lebanon 5, Iraq 5, Syria 4); the 1949 Armistice Agreements and 1948 Arab-Israeli War pages are cited by more than one dossier, so lebanon lists 7 sources and kingdom-of-iraq 7 against budgets of 5.

WebFetch answers through a small summarising model; the 1948 Arab-Israeli War page was read only to character 100,000 of 122,137. Two guessed page titles were not found and one was a disambiguation page (pages_failed).

Overlaps to settle at compile time: kingdom-of-saudi-arabia 1932-1935 against kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd (Cliopatria's row 1926-1935); kingdom-of-iraq January-July 1958 against Cliopatria's Arab Federation row; second-syrian-republic January-February 1958 against the first year of united-arab-republic; lebanon 1943 against the French Mandate row.

Lebanon and french-mandate-for-syria-and-lebanon share Wikidata Q139708 but are kept as two states. kingdom-of-iraq and kingdom-of-saudi-arabia differ from Cliopatria's years (Iraq 1921-1958, Saudi 1932-2024).

The north-yemen dossier names kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd as counterpart for the 1932-1934 Saudi events; kingdom-of-saudi-arabia names north-yemen. Counterpart strings differ until kingdom-of-hejaz-and-nejd is aligned.
Lebanon has two validator warnings (occupation_start for state-of-israel for Ghajar from 2006 and for the invasion of 1 October 2024 with no end), because the pages give no end.

Some events lack a month because the validator requires (year, month) order and the page gives no month for the neighbouring event (Israeli withdrawal of 1978, British departure of 1947, the 1926 frontier treaty, the 1982 Iraq neutral-zone partition).
